items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: This fellow was named Homer Johnson. I don't know where he came from. He's dead.

ctx.x: After you left Jelly, you said you went to Tijuana then and played a violin?

Yeah. For Syl Stewart. It was called the Kansas City Bar. That's where he was originated from. They named it the Kansas City Bar. This fellow was named Homer Johnson. I don't know where he came from. He's dead.
Oh, Jelly named a piece called the Kansas City Stump.
